svg.title: Laminar Flat-Plate Boundary Layer validation
svg.desc: Numerical similarity profiles match the supplied analytical Blasius profile. Skin-friction values are paired with the independent ODE-Blasius references in the manuscript-generating qualification export. Maximum relative errors are 0.06025% in displacement thickness, 0.06684% in momentum thickness, 0.03086% in shape factor and 0.11192% in skin friction.

g.text: Across displacement thickness, momentum thickness, H₁₂ and Cf
Maximum relative errors · laminar validation; no transition claim
